records.title: Welfare Schemes for Tribal Youth in Hingoli
details: a to d: the establishment of an Eklavya Model Residential School (EMRS) is under process. As per Government Resolution dated 09.10.2020, a total of 15 acres of land is required. Out of this, 7.5 acres have already been acquired at Shivani (Taluka Kalamnuri). The acquisition of the remaining land is in progress, and upon completion, the proposal will be submitted to the National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS) for approval.
